description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's ignored mode behavior. It sets up various scenarios to verify how 'git status' reports files with different ignored and tracked states, testing command options like --ignored and --untracked-files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the enclosed commands, and checks the output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be run after a test case completes, typically for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output against expected content to verify correctness.
